body.p: Formerly serpents were harmless and they would have remained so had it not been for Tawkxwax. He is a fool, a trickster. He got the silly idea of taking a live serpent and heating its mouth. From time to time he let it bite him in order to see the results of his burning. He would not stop until the fangs of the serpent were full of poison. Then the serpent bit him and Tawkxwax became very ill. Since then serpents have been dangerous.
